card.name: Small words opening a preparation step
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as in, a, the, or a comma right after the start of an instruction step. They are followed by a container, tool or surface, in recipes and drug preparation directions.

modes.label: Recipe step openers
modes.description: The word in or a large after a cooking instruction, before a pot or pan.
modes.example: Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil<< in>> Dutch oven over high heat until just starting

modes.label: Drug preparation steps
modes.description: A, the, or new after In or With, before a syringe, glass or tube.
modes.example: To prepare RETEVMO tablet as a dispersion: In<< a>> glass or medicine cup, add the correct

modes.label: Comma after opening phrase
modes.description: A comma after a short setup phrase, before the next action.
modes.example: On a clean, dry surface<<,>> open carton and remove the contents.
